title: Ensure Work Video is actually added and visible (video upload + robust defaults)

requirements.text: Add a clear, user-facing way to add a real video to the Work Video section by supporting local video file upload (e.g., .mp4/.webm) and playing it inline with standard controls.
acceptanceCriteria: In the Work Video section, users can choose a video file from their device via a file picker.
After selecting a video, the page shows an inline HTML5 <video> player with Play/Pause, seek, volume, and fullscreen controls.
If the user clears/removes the selected video, the UI returns to the default Work Video experience (montage or placeholder).
All user-facing labels and messages in this feature are in English.

requirements.text: Make the default Work Video montage reliably render by validating default asset paths and adding a graceful fallback when an image fails to load.
acceptanceCriteria: If any default montage image URL from WORK_PHOTOS fails to load, the Work Video section shows a clear English fallback state (e.g., “Work video is not available yet. Please upload a video or add photos.”) instead of a blank/black canvas.
The app does not crash if one or more montage images are missing or fail to load.
WORK_PHOTOS is updated to only reference files that actually exist in the frontend public assets, or the code is updated to avoid relying on missing paths.

requirements.text: Update the Work Video UI so it is obvious what content is being shown (uploaded video vs. photo montage), and provide a simple control to switch/clear the current selection.
acceptanceCriteria: The Work Video section indicates whether the user is viewing an uploaded video or the photo montage.
There is an explicit control to remove/clear the uploaded video selection and revert to montage mode.
The section remains responsive and visually consistent with the existing site styling (Tailwind + existing UI components).

constraints: Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose these components instead).

Do not modify frontend immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, and all files in frontend/src/components/ui.
Keep the backend as a single Motoko actor; do not introduce additional backend services.
nonGoals: Do not implement third-party video hosting/streaming or external storage integrations.
Do not add real-time features (no WebSockets).
Do not add non-Internet-Identity auth providers.
